notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 46,900.00 under your LPO HMBE/LPO/2026/001 Ver. 2. Received to date QAR 44,555.00 — the 70% advance of QAR 32,830.00 on 21-09-2026 under cheque 00000001, and QAR 11,725.00 by this receipt. BALANCE QAR 2,345.00, being the 5% payable on successful testing, commissioning and handover.

Received with thanks, subject to realisation of the cheque. The amount in words and in figures agree at QAR 11,725.00, the payee name is correct and the cheque is crossed A/C Payee Only — for which our thanks. Our thanks also for your prompt settlement: the cheque is dated the day after our invoice.

WHAT REMAINS. Testing, commissioning and handover, after which the final 5% of QAR 2,345.00 falls due. We shall give you notice of the commissioning date and provide operation training at handover, as our quotation provides.

AMENDMENT TO THE ORDER STILL REQUESTED. Your purchase order Ver. 2 states the value in figures as QAR 46,900.00, which agrees with our contract and with the two payments now made, but the amount in words still reads "Qatari Riyals Forty-Five Thousand Three Hundred Only" from the earlier version. The three payments of 70%, 25% and 5% of QAR 46,900.00 come to QAR 32,830.00, QAR 11,725.00 and QAR 2,345.00, and the first two are now paid exactly so. We should be grateful for a short written amendment correcting the words, so that the final payment is not held up on a point of drafting.
This receipt is issued against INV-290/2026 and is subject to the terms of our quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ091/2026 (Ver. 3) and your LPO HMBE/LPO/2026/001 Ver. 2.
